g.text: Conditional water collisionality and resolution — static recorded electrons and fields
Stationary ground-state H₂O test targets; unsupported weight stays in every ensemble denominator.
Columns and Maxwellian plasma are explicit scenarios, not reconstructed gas, equilibrium, or an explanation of the halo.
